set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF)
set_directory_properties(PROPERTIES EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ON SYSTEM ON)
add_compile_definitions(_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_DEPRECATE _SCL_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
add_subdirectory(fmt)
set(ZYDIS_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ZYDIS_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(zydis)
add_subdirectory(xbyak)
add_subdirectory(magic_enum)
set(SDL_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(sdl3)
file(GLOB atrac9_sources LibAtrac9/C/src/*.c)
add_library(LibAtrac9 STATIC ${atrac9_sources})
target_include_directories(LibAtrac9 PUBLIC LibAtrac9/C/src)
add_subdirectory(ffmpeg)
add_library(Dear_ImGui STATIC imgui/imgui.cpp imgui/imgui_draw.cpp imgui/imgui_tables.cpp imgui/imgui_widgets.cpp
    imgui/backends/imgui_impl_sdl3.cpp imgui/backends/imgui_impl_vulkan.cpp)
target_include_directories(Dear_ImGui PUBLIC imgui)
target_link_libraries(Dear_ImGui PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3 PUBLIC Vulkan::Vulkan)
target_compile_definitions(Dear_ImGui PUBLIC IMGUI_DEFINE_MATH_OPERATORS)
target_compile_definitions(Dear_ImGui PUBLIC IMGUI_USER_CONFIG="${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ui/imgui_config.h")
add_library(xxhash STATIC xxhash/xxhash.c)
target_include_directories(xxhash PUBLIC xxhash)
file(GLOB zstd_sources zstd/common/*.c zstd/compress/*.c zstd/decompress/*.c zstd/dictBuilder/*.c)
add_library(zstd STATIC ${zstd_sources})
target_include_directories(zstd PUBLIC zstd)
target_compile_definitions(zstd PRIVATE ZSTD_DISABLE_ASM)
add_library(runtime_headers INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(runtime_headers SYSTEM INTERFACE stb)
